notes.title: Ceaseless Night — Out Now!
notes.notes:
Ceaseless Night is out now! The first game from JABDP Studio and certainly a project of passion. It's been an incredible experience developing Ceaseless Night; 1.5 years of crafting a game that we ourselves would be happy to play. A game of strategy and resource management, Ceaseless Night challenged us as developers to think hard about ways to balance fair punishment with satisfying rewards. From designing and tweaking assets, to listening to the soundtrack on repeat for motivation, and bug testing late at night, it truly is surreal to see our amazingly exciting project release.

So delve into the dungeons and end that Ceaseless Night. We hope you enjoy!
